text:
ana: Quick heads-up — milestone review tomorrow at 11. Need to lock scope for the Q2 milestone. My proposal: move full-tenant SSO to v1 (not in MVP), cut tenant routing / per-tenant network plumbing, keep embedding-cache + quantization work in MVP, and include a minimal 2FA email flow in MVP. Please react + one-line takes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: +1 to pushing full SSO to v1. Too many dependencies for this milestone. Concern: embedding-cache will need infra changes — not trivial. :thinking_face:

sam: Infra can support a scoped embedding cache if we remove per-tenant routing. That cut saves ~2 weeks of infra work. Recommend: keep cache, delay cross-tenant dedupe to v1. :white_check_mark:

jess: From design: 2FA email-first is workable for MVP. SMS/TOTP can be v1. If we cut tenant routing we also need to adjust account UX flows (account selector step). I'll sketch a compact flow. :pencil2:

alec: Data note — in internal tests embedding-cache reduced token counts by ~40% for 3 high-volume customers. High impact on cost. Strong argument for keeping it in MVP. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

mike: Operationally I'd like an explicit fallback: if latency > 400ms use quantized model variant + no-cache path. That keeps SLAs while we stabilize. Also need canary metrics defined.

ana: (typo) ana: sorry :) Consolidating: consensus forming to cut tenant routing and full SSO, keep embedding-cache + quant, do email-only 2FA in MVP. Action items: document cutlist, update milestone tracker, notify sales about scope change. Who picks up the cutlist doc?

jess: I'll own the cutlist doc and UX mocks. I'll create a short sheet with before/after flows and attach to the milestone ticket tomorrow AM.

sam: I'll own infra runbook updates and the canary plan. I'll create the canary env and a checklist for rollback triggers.

mike: I'll update the milestone tracker and the rollout policy. Quick rollout policy stub I suggest we add to the doc:

```json
{
  "canary_window_minutes": 30,
  "failure_threshold": 0.02,  // 2% error rate or 5xx
  "latency_threshold_ms": 400,
  "fallback_action": "route-to-quantized-variant"
}
```

deploy-bot: Canary env created: canary-q2-cache-01. URL: https://canary.redwood/internal/canary-q2-cache-01 :rocket:

alec: Also recommend a single eval prompt set to monitor quality drift for quantization. If embedding hit-rate drops >10% alert product and data.

ana: (again typo) ana: Thanks all. Next steps: jess posts cutlist doc link, sam posts canary runbook, mike updates milestone ticket and tags sales ops for customer messaging. If anyone objects to this plan, speak now; otherwise I'll mark scope as synced and start stakeholder comms. :bell:

mike: No objections. :thumbsup:

jess: No objections. Will post doc by 9am.

sam: No objections. I'll start infra work after the review.

alec: No objections. I'll prepare eval prompts.

ana: ana: OK locking scope unless anything else surfaces. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
